parameters.content:
## 1 Brief and source
Basic Auth form -> run folder -> disclaimer must equal the rulebook's -> source.mp4 (upload, or https link) -> beats parsed and checked with /reframe.

## 2 Scripts
Rulebook -> LLM (2 hooks x 3 lengths, 3 b-roll shots each, structured output) -> shape check.

## 3 Compliance
Hard word list (/lint) on lines and shots; a judge LLM rules on the lines only (shots are pre-approved). Rewrite once, lint again, drop. A shot with a word-list hit is dropped.

## 4 Look line (spec 4.3 part 1)
Vision on the middles of S1, S3, S5; one retry if the word list hits; then the rulebook's look_fallback. The brief's Look overrides.

## 5 B-roll
Dry run: stand-in clips copied to runs/<id>/broll/ (12 files). Live (pods + /api/broll): disabled stub, the toolkit side is not deployed. Run stops at '→ 12b: render', which receives the whole run state (with `slots`).
